name: sdk-log-expert
description: SDK Log Expert — analyze Tencent RTC SDK client logs locally. Decode .clog/.xlog binary logs, unzip archives, build TRTC/IM/TUI timelines, and serve an interactive local Web preview for evidence-based troubleshooting.

displayDescription.en: Client-side SDK log analysis: unzip & decode .clog/.xlog, TRTC/IM/TUI timeline reconstruction, evidence-based root-cause diagnosis, and interactive local Web preview.
displayDescription.zh: 解码客户端日志，还原 TRTC/IM/TUI 时间线，定位音视频与 IM 相关根因

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我解码并分析这个 .clog 文件，定位卡顿/进房失败的原因
defaultInitPrompt.en: Decode and analyze this .clog file to locate the lag / join-room failure cause

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我解码并分析这个 .clog 文件，定位卡顿/进房失败的原因
quickPrompts.en: Decode and analyze this .clog file to locate the lag / join-room failure cause

quickPrompts.zh: 这是一个日志压缩包，帮我解压后按时间线分析关键事件
quickPrompts.en: This is a log archive — unzip it and analyze the key events on a timeline

quickPrompts.zh: 分析完成后启动 Web 预览，让我按行号核对证据日志
quickPrompts.en: After analysis, start the Web preview so I can verify the evidence logs by line number
